text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: —Waaah~! Trainer, look, tatami mats!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: A hanging scroll!
choice_data_list: That's a hanging scroll, all right.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
This feels like a traditional Japanese hot 
spring inn! How lovely~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, Fine Motion and I were on a hot 
spring trip that I had won in a lottery 
earlier.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "...I should give this ticket to you."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Back then, it wasn't certain whether Fine 
Motion would even be able to go on a hot 
springs trip.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, since her settlement in Japan was 
finalized, I gave her the hot spring trip 
ticket once again, and—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Of course you're coming with me, right, 
Trainer? Then let's pick a date!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And so, I ended up coming to the hot 
springs with the bodyguards.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Let's hit the hot springs right away! 
Let's dive right in, splash!
choice_data_list: Be quiet in the hot spring, you hear?
Be quiet in the hot spring, okay?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yeees♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: That was a wonderful bath~♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! My mind, body, and tail are all 
moisturized, glossy, and silky smooth♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder if we could pipe a hot spring 
into our castle, too~?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to open it up to everyone else 
too, so all the folks in Ireland can enjoy 
it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Captain—

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure everyone is informed later. 
...Now, if you'll excuse us.

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
On His Highness's orders, I have arranged 
separate lodgings. Though of course, it's 
just a stone's throw away...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Since we're at a hot spring resort, I 
wanted everyone to truly unwind and 
stretch their wings without worrying about 
a thing.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I've got Trainer with me, so I'll be fine♪ 
Right, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
...Well then, if anything comes up, no 
matter how minor it may seem, please 
contact me immediately.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Understood!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone's really devoted to their 
work, huh?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
She said she wouldn't leave my side. I 
couldn't help but make it an 'order.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They would probably be happier staying by 
Fine Motion's side, but... I decided to 
keep that to myself.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, how about we take a little 
stroll before dinner?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There is something that's been on my mind. 
Earlier, Fine Motion told the Captain of 
the Guard that she wanted him to "let his 
hair down," but...
choice_data_list: (I wonder how she feels about it?)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Why are you staring at me? Is it because 
my skin is so radiant?
choice_data_list:
Are you able to spread your wings right 
now?

Are you able to spread your wings right 
now?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Huh! Can you not see it, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Look, look closer! I've got pure white 
wings on my back, don't I?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
See how it flutters and stretches out! 
Anyone with a pure heart should be able to 
see it, right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Very well♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You know, I really love being with you. Or 
rather, I love who I am when I'm with you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Of course I also like the version of 
myself that spends time with friends, or 
the one called 'Your Highness', you know?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
However, when I'm with you... I'm way more 
selfish, stubborn, and kind of a handful 
than usual.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ufufu.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Geez, could you at least deny it a little? 
Especially the "lame" part!
choice_data_list:
And on top of that, she's incredibly 
noble.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ehe. Guess that lives up to Her Highness's 
reputation♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Right. That's why, you know? From here on, 
too...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Forever and always! Please let me stay 
your Fine Motion.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond with Fine Motion...
